policy.materialCorrection: Record changes that materially alter the meaning of an important published professional, technical, research, benchmark, dataset, identity, status or evidence claim.
policy.editorialChange: Spelling, layout, accessibility, broken-link, metadata normalization and generated-inventory changes normally do not require an entry unless they alter material meaning.
policy.historyRule: Preserve enough prior-state context to explain the correction rather than silently presenting the corrected state as if the earlier claim never existed.
